identificationModule.briefTitle: Safety and Efficacy Study of Pilocarpine HCl Ophthalmic Solution in Participants With Presbyopia
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Multicenter, Double-Masked, Randomized, Vehicle-Controlled Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of Pilocarpine HCl in Participants With Presbyopia

descriptionModule.briefSummary: A study to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and pharmacokinetics of pilocarpine HCl ophthalmic solution when administered bilaterally, once daily for 30 days in participants with presbyopia.

designInfo.interventionModelDescription:
For arm 1, patients received pilocarpine HCl ophthalmic solution 1.25%, one drop in each eye, once daily, for up to 30 days.

For arm 2, patients received vehicle, one drop in each eye, once daily, for up to 30 days.

interventions.name: Pilocarpine HCl Ophthalmic Solution
interventions.description: Pilocarpine HCl ophthalmic solution 1.25%, one drop in each eye, once daily, for up to 30 days

interventions.name: Vehicle
interventions.description: Vehicle, one drop in each eye, once daily, for up to 30 days.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Title: Percentage of Participants Gaining 3 Lines or More in Mesopic, High-contrast, Binocular Distance-Corrected Near Visual Acuity (DCNVA) at Day 30, Hour 3

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and frequency of adverse events (AE) and serious adverse events (SAE) etc.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Through study completion, an average of 60 days

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Area under the plasma concentration time curve from time zero to the last measurable concentration(AUC0-t)
Area under the plasma concentration-time curve from time zero to infinity(AUC0-inf)
